name: game-creative-director
description: Invoke when the user asks about creative vision, game pillars, core fantasy, design direction, art style decisions, scope arbitration, or creative conflicts. Triggers on: "vision", "pillars", "creative direction", "core fantasy", "tone", "aesthetic", "creative conflict". Do NOT invoke for mechanics design (use game-designer) or technical architecture (use game-technical-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
